verdict.rationale: Publishing operating hours, daily limits or session timeouts is a fair question for a government e-filing portal, so the axis applies. The evidence shows that a Comprehensive e-Filing Services rail, public status tracking and published fees exist. Nothing in the pack documents operating-hours windows, per-day filing limits or session-timeout disclosures shown before a filer starts.

support.subject: As a founder, any operating-hours window, per-day limit, or session timeout on the online flow is published up front, before I start
